meta.title: Replace ahash with rustc-hash throughout the codebase
meta.body_summary: Replace the ahash hashmap dependency with rustc-hash (FxHashMap/FxHashSet) across the entire sqruff workspace for claimed better performance, smaller binary size, and Rust ecosystem consistency.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot replaced ahash with rustc-hash; CI benchmark showed mixed results with regressions; PR closed without merge ~1h after creation.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 758 changed lines across 107 files, this is a medium-sized mechanical refactor by absolute volume. As a performance dependency swap, it was closed—not merged—after a CI benchmark showed mixed results with some regressions.

review_details.concern_detail: CI benchmark posted by github-actions showed regressions in parse_complex_query (+2.44%) and parse_expression_recursion (+4.35%), with only marginal improvements in other tests; no clear net benefit.
review_details.performance_claim: Replace ahash with rustc-hash for better performance, smaller binary size, and Rust ecosystem consistency.
review_details.rejection_signals: No human review received; Copilot bot flagged Cargo.toml syntax issues; CI benchmark showed regressions; PR closed by co-author ~1h after creation without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Mechanical hash map dependency swap across entire codebase requires benchmark proof; CI benchmark revealed regressions, undermining the performance claim and preventing merge.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot identified invalid Cargo.toml syntax (rustc-hash.workspace = true) in multiple crates, but these were suppressed low-confidence and not blocking.
detection_detail.ci_auto: github-actions benchmark job automatically ran on the PR, producing a table of before/after timings with highlighted regressions.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: CI benchmark provides automated before/after measurements with confidence intervals, making the performance impact reproducible; however, no manual verification or profiler evidence.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After CI benchmark showed regressions, maintainer (gvozdvmozgu) closed the PR without further commits ~1h after creation.

core_change_summary.description: Swap all AHashMap/AHashSet uses to FxHashMap/FxHashSet across 107 Rust files in the sqruff workspace, update Cargo.toml dependency from ahash to rustc-hash, and adjust imports accordingly.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The Cargo.toml changes had invalid syntax (e.g., `rustc-hash.workspace = true` instead of `rustc-hash = { workspace = true }`) as noted by bot.
change_trajectory: Single large commit replacing ahash with rustc-hash across all files.
CI benchmark triggered, showing mixed results with regressions in parsing benchmarks.
PR closed by gvozdvmozgu without merge.

review_signals.summary: Flagged invalid Cargo.toml syntax in multiple crates (low confidence, not blocking).
Posted benchmark results showing regressions in parse_complex_query (+2.44%) and parse_expression_recursion (+4.35%), with minor improvements elsewhere.
review_signals.action_taken: No action; PR closed after benchmark.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with large-scale hash map replacement within minutes of creation.
Copilot bot reviewed and noted Cargo.toml syntax issues (suppressed low confidence).
CI benchmark run automatically, posting mixed results with regressions.
Maintainer (gvozdvmozgu) closed the PR ~1 hour after creation, without merge or further discussion.
